info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce Connect REST API (Communities)

description.content:
Access community data, feeds, topics, and user engagement features. The Connect REST API provides endpoints for social collaboration, content sharing, and community management within Experience Cloud sites. Includes feed operations, topic management, and member engagement.
